kind: read-only implementation design; not an active plan
scope: P21 Office location feedback on existing verified XLSX/DOCX previews; no Office editing, external application, new Agent capability, or automatic send.
recommendation: Prioritize XLSX cell/merged-range feedback on the existing detail UI. Add bounded visible-window rectangle selection with explicit addresses if included in the same complete slice. DOCX paragraph/whole-table feedback requires a small parser source-position addition first; current generated view IDs are insufficient for historical source positions.

currentEvidence.fact: Cells retain original row/column/reference and typed value/cache state. Sheet metadata retains relationship id/name/state, sheet result retains full merges.
Exposed sheet id originates from workbook relationship r:id, not the current displayed tab index.
WorkbookPosition distinguishes clipped display row/column, original merged range, partial merge and hidden original anchor. Never use the clipped display coordinate as the full merged target.
Current detail panel already knows selection, current workbook/sheet and original merge. This provides an existing explicit-action surface.
block-N is allocated from a parser-wide counter. It is not an OOXML source coordinate or a stable paragraph ordinal.
story-N is allocated by discovery order; original part is available internally but not retained in DocxStory output.
paragraphParts slices presentation into at most 1000 runs/40000 characters; these segments are not Word pages or source paragraphs.
Table detail retains sourceRow/sourceColumn and true spans separately from visible clipped cells; BlockSequence mounts only a bounded content window.

Existing parent preparation validates complete capture/parse before replacement; children recheck exact file/attempt before ready. Position feedback must retain this ownership, not create a second file read or body ledger.

xlsxSlice.source: Ephemeral owner containing the exact successful WorkbookCapture/file + current WorkbookPreview/sheet object. A matching name or DTO shape alone is not a fresh source.

anchorProposal.sheetId: actual relationship id from current workbook
anchorProposal.sheetName: bounded literal name for historical display

xlsxSlice.singleAndMerged: Single cell uses one coordinate, including real empty visible positions. A merged-cell action uses the complete original merge bounds and clearly labels the full merged range even when the visible window is clipped. A hidden original anchor is not silently revealed or selectable until the user explicitly chooses to display hidden rows/columns.
xlsxSlice.rectangle: Optional first-slice range form uses A1:B4 plus existing parseCellAddress. Require every ordinary requested coordinate inside the current visible 100x24 window; reject hidden gaps unless explicitly shown, and reject ranges crossing unseen groups. Do not auto-load additional sheets, silently expand partial merges or claim all offscreen cells were inspected.
xlsxSlice.operation: Existing cell detail gets 对此单元格/合并范围提意见. Merely clicking a cell, navigating or changing sheet only changes the candidate; explicit action updates the common opinion target while preserving its text.
xlsxSlice.limits: Honor worksheet bounds 1048576 rows/16384 columns and existing bounded window. Persist coordinates and bounded names only, not cell content/formula/clipboard snapshots. Formula/cache values retain existing incomplete-format notices.

docxSlice.dependency: Retain source part name and the actual parsed XML element-child path on each supported p/tbl, before filtering/compatibility selection. Map the original DocxXml nodes, including chosen AlternateContent descendants, to paths while the bounded part tree exists; do not infer from output block-N or displayed segment order.

anchorProposal.part: validated OPC part name from the current captured package
anchorProposal.elementPath: bounded zero-based XML element-child indices from that part root

docxSlice.sourceOwnership: Retain the exact DocxPreview object plus source-backed block. The current view/story/block must actually be mounted and active; a notice placeholder is not a selectable source block.
docxSlice.firstTargets: Paragraph as a whole or table as a whole. A paragraph may be visually split, and a table window may be partial: target labels must say whole paragraph/table and keep existing partial-content notices. Do not claim Word page, screen line, individual run range or arbitrary nested-cell feedback.
docxSlice.stories: Part/path supports body and explicitly selected header/footer/footnote/endnote without inventing page placement. Preserve original note id only as display context where available. Source IDs and missing content are not reconstructed from user-visible labels.
docxSlice.revalidation: A new full version or a changed parser output cannot automatically retarget an old opinion. To call a saved location currently checked, read the exact original version and resolve that same part/path/kind against real captured source; absent/mismatched remains historical and usable as such.

sharedApi.availability: onOfficeTargetAvailability({source,available}); false names the retiring source so a late cleanup cannot clear a newer candidate.
sharedApi.confirm: onOfficeTargetConfirm({source,anchor}); child immediately checks current ready/active/attempt and exact sheet/block; parent independently checks current file/version/thread and no replace operation before changing the common draft.
sharedApi.persistence: Extend the discriminated FeedbackAnchor union and every strict parser/formatter. Keep existing path/contentId disk version+SHA and unsentWork.v1 container; unknown fields/kinds reject the protected snapshot as today. No serialized fresh flag, parallel body index or access-grant token.
sharedApi.transfer: Common take appends one original-version location description and user opinion to the composer in the existing atomic snapshot. Escape literal sheet/part labels as data. Do not send automatically, evaluate formulas, open Office, or add an Agent tool.

failureProtection: Before real child ready, while changing sheet/story/group, after hide/cancel/parse error, and during version replacement, new targets are unavailable; historical drafts remain intact.
A valid previous selection must not be relabelled with a new sheet, recycled relationship id, clipped merge coordinate, new paragraph counter, or restored reading-position ref.

Wrong type/path/range, missing original merge, stale child callback, unmounted block and hidden original data reject confirmation. Pending native capture keeps the existing single-flight and explicit retry rules.
Saved historical anchors are displayed as prior selections; shape-valid JSON alone is never current-disk validation. Source body is never persisted by this feature.

independentValidationFeasible.fixtures: Reuse existing independent python-docx ordinary writer documents and real Rust XLSX/DOCX capture receipts, plus small synthetic files for merged/hidden cells and source-node paths. Do not modify frozen fixtures or infer successful selection from parser success alone.
cases: XLSX 0/false/empty cell/missing formula cache each retain exact selected coordinate and displayed distinction.
Merged cell spans two view windows; original full bounds survive clipping. Hidden anchor stays protected until explicit show-hidden.
Sheet switch/rename/reused id and same-path new SHA invalidate candidates, preserving old opinions.
DOCX repeated text, inserted preceding paragraph, ignored marker and AlternateContent do not confuse source element paths.
Body/header/footer/footnote with identical text resolve distinct parts/paths; no fabricated page number.
Long split paragraph and clipped table are labelled whole targets, not current segment pages; unsupported notice blocks cannot become targets.
Pointer and keyboard explicit action both preserve opinion text; late ready/callback, hide, failed parse and restore cannot confirm stale targets.
Cold draft restore/unknown fields/take once/settings-write failure preserve the existing atomic protections.
independentValidationFeasible.levels: Pure strict parser/runtime tests -> real worker capture/path mapping -> controlled React/DOM interaction -> installed WKWebView separately. No test or implementation for this future slice has run.
